title: Heat adaptation document preparation
description: Preparation metadata and status defined in DESIGN.md Appendix A.
$comment: Enable date and date-time format checking. Python must also check project-relative paths, file existence, agreement with the registered PDF, and consistency with pages.json. A status value records the preparation outcome; the schema cannot establish PDF readability or extraction accuracy.

schema_version.description: Version 3 adds candidate image detection, preserved images, and mixed text. Version 2 remains readable.

plan_id.description: Identifier of the registered document being prepared.

pdf_path.description: Project-relative path to the preserved original PDF.

document_sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the original PDF as 64 hexadecimal characters.

source_url.description: Source URL copied from the document registry; URL syntax checks are performed by Python.

date_accessed.description: Collection access date copied from the registry, written as YYYY-MM-DD.

prepared_at.$comment: The format checker validates the calendar and time. The pattern requires UTC, represented by Z or +00:00. Reject whitespace explicitly because some regular-expression end anchors allow a final newline.
prepared_at.description: UTC timestamp of this preparation attempt, such as 2026-11-02T10:30:00Z.

pages_path.description: Project-relative path to this preparation's preserved pages.json file.

page_count.description: Number of original PDF pages, or null when a failed attempt could not determine it.

settings.$comment: Python supplies defaults before saving. Validation never fills missing settings. OCR details describe the configured engine, not proof that any page used OCR.
settings.description: Shared OCR and rendering settings saved once for this preparation.

ocr_enabled.description: Whether an OCR engine was configured for selective preparation fallback.

ocr_version.description: Installed OCR package version, or null while OCR is disabled.

ocr_language.description: Configured engine language code, or null while OCR is disabled.

candidate_image_min_area.description: Minimum visible page-area fraction for one image region with no native text within its bounds.

status.description: Recorded outcome of the preparation checks; it does not establish semantic accuracy.

problem.description: Explanation of a preparation problem, or null when none is recorded.

then.$comment: Usable preparations require a known page count. A failed preparation may have a known count or an unavailable count.
